messages:
maria.g: quick kickoff: finalizing the webinar + lab-kit experiment. goal = drive devs to a successful first query within 48h after signup. seed 500, then ramp.
jon_k: short hypothesis: bundling a tiny "lab-kit" (templates + one-click import) + modest starter credits beats credits-only for dev activation. we'll A/B narrative: Perf-led vs Kit-led.
priya.s: copy plan: two launch post variants and two webinar CTAs. Kit-led will show a tiny "ship in 2 min" workflow. Perf-led will show a reproducible micro-benchmark.
ash: bench snippet to include (very small):
```bash
# micro-bench example
redwood-bench --model rwd-2-small --seq 256 --batch 8 --iters 200
```
ash: makes the claim verifiable.
kai: routing: split landing traffic into kits(55%), credits(35%), control(10%) using utm_variant. webhook should include utm_variant + session_id + kit_opt_in.
rachel: email subject options to seed 500: A) "See our micro-bench + live demo" B) "Ship an LLM feature in minutes with starter kit". bias B for product-adjacent list.
priya.s: post-webinar follow-up cadence: immediate replay + lab-kit + 60 credits (14d expiry), day2 quickstart checklist, day5 success template + office hours invite, day9 conversion nudge.
jon_k: analytics events: webinar_signup, landing_variant, kit_imported, credit_claimed, first_success_query. dashboard funnel: signup -> import -> query -> paid.
kai: growth-bot experiment config: cohorts kits(55%), credits(35%), control(10%); primary metric first_success_query(48h); success threshold +2.5% abs; alert channel #marketing.
growth-bot: seed experiment scheduled 09:00 PT tomorrow; will monitor 24h lift and failover.
maria.g: owners: content priya+jon, eng ash, analytics kai, ops rachel. deliverables by Fri EOD: two post drafts, reproducible bench appendix, UTMs, webhook schema, kit quickstart stub.
jon_k: i'll drop social copy in #marketing-drafts for review.
priya.s: i'll queue the seed send and report opens/clicks by EOD tomorrow.
ash: engineering will deliver one-click kit import + node snippet (minimal) by Thursday.
maria.g: thanks team. keep copy developer-first and keep the benchmark link obvious. end thread.
